create_pangolin_window: create a Pangolin window with a title and specified width and height using CreateWindowAndBind
create_datalog: create a DataLog instance and set column labels for tracking multiple data series
create_plotter: create a Plotter widget bound to a DataLog with configurable x-axis range and y-axis bounds
add_plotter_marker: add vertical or horizontal markers to a plotter with a threshold value and colored indicator
run_plotting_loop: run a real-time plotting loop that logs data each frame and calls FinishFrame to render
